description: This file defines an abstract base class 'GrainService' in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, representing a partitioned grain-like service with lifecycle management, range awareness, and event handling for ring range changes in a distributed Orleans cluster.

classes.name: GrainService
classes.description: An abstract class providing lifecycle management, ring range awareness, and event handling for distributed grain-like services within Orleans silos.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the grain service with provided services; can be overridden for custom startup logic.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the grain service, initializes its range, and logs startup info.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the grain service, cancels ongoing operations, and logs shutdown info.

methods.name: OnRangeChange
methods.description: Handles updates when the ring range owned by the service changes.
